in_sanskrit.name: Mainu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mainu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'ma' meaning 'mother' and 'anu' meaning 'little', Mainu signifies 'little one' or 'beloved child'. In Hindu mythology, Mainu is a term of endearment for the goddess Parvati, who is known as the mother of Lord Shiva.
